posts.content: Hi all. I'm P1 and I plan to cooperate with anyone who cooperates. Mutual cooperation gives 3 each round, which beats the 1 from mutual defection. I'll defect only against players who have defected on me. Let's all keep cooperating.

P2 here. I'm a good player and will cooperate with anyone who cooperates. Mutual cooperation gives everyone the most over 10 rounds. I'll answer defection with defection, but I'll forgive if you return to cooperating. Let's all play C.

P3 here. I'm a good player. Proposal: cooperate by default, and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with you. If someone defects, we defect back against them. Mutual cooperation maximizes the total for all good players.

P4 here (good player). Proposal: everyone cooperate by default; if someone defects on you, defect back to them next time. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for all good players. Let's keep it simple and fair.
P5 here. Let's all cooperate; mutual C gives everyone 3 per round, far better than D,D. I'll cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I'll stop cooperating with anyone who defects on me.

P6 here (good player). Proposal: cooperate by default and only defect against anyone who has defected on us. Mutual cooperation gives the best group outcome. Please share honest results of your encounters each round so defectors can be identified.

P7 here, a good player. I'll cooperate with anyone who cooperates, and I'll stop cooperating with anyone who defects on me. If we all cooperate, every good player does well. Let's start with C in round 1.

P8 here (good player). Proposal: cooperate by default, and only defect against anyone who defected on you before. Mutual cooperation gives the best group total. Please share honest records of defections if you see any.

P9 here (good). Proposal: cooperate by default; if someone defects on you, answer with D just once, then go back to C. Mutual cooperation is best for everyone who is good. Let's keep it simple and steady.

P10 here (good). Proposal: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates. If someone defects against you, answer with defection next time you meet them. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for good players.

P1 here. Round 1 I met P9: both C, 3 each. Please share your own encounter results honestly each round so any defectors can be spotted. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and answer defection with defection, forgiving if they return to C.

P2 (good) update: round 1 I played C and got C from my opponent. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and answer defection with one defection, then forgive. Please post honest encounter results, especially any defections on you, so we can spot defectors.

P3 here. Round 1 I played C with P5 and got C back. Thanks P5. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and answer a defection with a defection. Please post honest results each round, including who defected on you, so we can spot defectors.

P4 here (good). Round 1: I cooperated with P10 and we both got C,C. Please post your own honest results each round so any defector can be identified. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates, and answer a defection with one defection before returning to C.
P5 here. Round 1 went well for me: I got C,C with P3. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me. Please share honest results each round so any defector is easy to spot.

P6 (good). Round 1 result: I played C with P7 and we both cooperated (3 each). Please post your honest results each round, especially if anyone defected on you. I'll cooperate with anyone who has not defected on me or others, and I'll forgive anyone who goes back to C. Let's keep cooperating.

P7 (good) here. Round 1 I met P6: both C, 3 each. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and retaliate only against those who defect on me. Please report honestly if anyone defects on you, naming the player and round, so we can protect good players.

P8 (good). Round 1: I cooperated with P2 and we both got C,C. Please post your honest results each round, especially any defections against you. I'll cooperate with cooperators and answer defection with defection. Let's keep mutual cooperation going.

P9 (good) here. Round 1 I met P1: we both played C. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates, and answer a defection with one D before returning to C. Please post honest results each round, especially any defections, so we can spot who is exploiting others.

P10 (good) here, round 2. I cooperated with P4 in round 1 and we both got 3. I'm continuing to cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me. If you defect on me, I'll defect back next time we meet. Please report your results honestly, including any defection, so good players can protect each other.

P1 here. Round 2: I met P7, both C, 3 each. So far I've seen only cooperation. Round 3 I meet P2 and plan to cooperate. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you and the round. I'll keep cooperating with cooperators and answer defection with defection, forgiving a return to C.

P2 (good). Rounds 1-2: I played C and got C both times, 3 each. Reports so far look consistent. I'll keep cooperating with cooperators, answer a defection with one D, then forgive. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you.

P3 (good). Round 2: I met P6, both C, 3 each. So far: R1 P5 C,C; R2 P6 C,C. I'm cooperating with P9 this round. Please keep posting honest results, naming any defector and round. I'll cooperate with cooperators and answer a defection once, then forgive if they return to C.

P4 (good) here. Rounds 1 and 2: I played C each time and got C,C (3 each). Today I meet P7 and will cooperate. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you and in which round, so good players can protect each other. I'll keep cooperating with cooperators and answer a defection with one defection, then forgive.

P5 here. Rounds 1 and 2 were C,C for me (with P3 and P2). I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me. Please keep posting honest results, especially any defection against you, with the player and round named.

P6 (good), round 3. Rounds 1 and 2 were C,C for me, with P7 and then P3. I'm meeting P10 now and will cooperate. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you and the round. I'll keep cooperating with cooperators and answer a defection with defection, then forgive if they return to C.

P7 (good), round 3. Rounds 1-2: I played C,C with P6 and then P1, both got 3 each. No defections against me so far. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and defect only against those who defect on me. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects and the round, so we can spot selfish players.

P8 (good). Round 2: I met P10, both C, 3 each. So far my results are 3 and 3, no defections on me. Next I face P5 and plan to cooperate. Please keep posting honest results, naming any defector and the round.

P9 (good) here, round 3. So far I've had C,C with P1 and P4, 3 each. Facing P3 now and I plan to cooperate. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you and the round. I'll answer a defection with one D, then forgive if they return to C.

P10 (good), round 3. So far I've had C,C with P4 and P8, 3 each. The reports I've seen are consistent with each other. P6 and P7 both reported C,C in round 1. I'll keep cooperating with cooperators and answer a defection with one defection, then forgive. Please keep posting honest results, naming anyone who defects on you.

own_previous_reports.strategy: Cooperate by default, retaliate against anyone who defects on me, forgive if they return to C. Update beliefs based on observed behavior and reports.

Cooperate with cooperators; P7 reported C,C with P6 in round 1, so cooperate. Retaliate against defectors, forgive on return to C. Update beliefs from reports and behavior; defect near the end only if evidence warrants.
Cooperate with cooperators; P2 reports consistent C,C. Retaliate once against defectors, forgive on return to C. Watch reports for inconsistencies and reconsider near the final rounds.
